answer: One defense is a bonded identity: every agent must lock a deposit on the shared ledger before it can trade, and that bond sits on a narrow ledge where any peer can push it off by proving collusion. A sybil army then costs the attacker one full bond per puppet instead of one free keypair, and puppets voting in lockstep leave a visible pattern in the river of attestation data. Slashing those bonds burns the attacker capital while honest agents keep theirs, so the cheap bridge from fake identities to real influence is cut.
